name: Eaton County, MI
findings: Eaton County has 451 nonprofit organizations. 226 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 188 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Eaton County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
